root_theory_intervals.activity: Current-source derivation, observer transport/feature redundancy analysis, synthetic mathematical checks, literature and agent synthesis

timing.overhead_basis: Conservative20-minute allowance for orientation, coordination, record handling and tool overhead within the theory interval; final state/verification/commit closeout excluded entirely.

rcerc.scope: Exact controls, full-head influence, QR theorem, fitting-noise and grammar reviews

uniform.scope: Uniform/compression, partial controls, exact propagation/covariance cost
uniform.note: Final under2-minute wording correction excluded from theory credit.

current_shape.scope: Conditional shape, full cumulants, H3 product and late cost re-ranking

timing.agent_time_note: Approximate active mathematical/source-analysis categories only; record/tool overhead and gaps between assignments excluded. These overlap root and each other, and do not multiply elapsed theory credit.
timing.end_definition: Theory and record checkoff; final integrity verification, scoped commit and chat delivery follow, separately timestamped in VERIFICATION.json.

reserve: R4IF8-P; full specification retained after late cost/time re-ranking
geometry_scope: Registered source/feature-span summaries, no complete candidate prediction or target fit
agent_followups: Concrete bounded follow-ups reused existing agents; all agent research complete before root closeout.
verification: Recorded synthetic mathematics and static source/cost checks; no production qualification. Final integrity checks follow in VERIFICATION.json.
